I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is her own June 9 message in that channel. She wrote that the morning receiver there saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver arrived at 7:10, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template, but nothing posted in #central-team since then says it was fixed.

I checked that Pree is a member of #central-team before reading it, and only used that channel.
